content:
Connor O'Brien: :loudspeaker: Heads up — **SIEM-ready Audit Export** is now available for **internal beta enablement** (Hosted + Dedicated only). Feature is gated behind a tenant allowlist + kill switch.

What it is:
• Export Redwood audit events to **Splunk (HEC)**, **Datadog Logs**, or **S3 delivery**
• Configurable filtering (categories/actions) + backfill window
• Exporter provides **at-least-once delivery** (downstream should dedup on `event_id`)
• Observability: lag, retries, per-destination health

What it is NOT (beta constraints):
• **Private / on-prem** support is out of scope for beta
• Not “exactly-once” — duplicates possible during retries/replays
• Backfill is bounded; don’t promise “full history”

How to request enablement:
1) File internal ticket: **INT-9012** (Helpdesk) → “Enable SIEM Audit Export beta for tenant allowlist”
   • include tenant/workspace id, desired destination (Splunk/Datadog/S3), region, and a customer point of contact
2) Tag **@Talia Benson** + **@Naomi Feldman** for PM approval + cohort tracking
3) After allowlist is set, customer admin can configure exports in Console (Settings → Audit Export)

Docs / runbooks / FAQ:
• Runbook (on-call): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Runbook+-+Audit+Exporter+Delivery+Failures
• SLOs + alerting: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Audit+Exporter+SLOs+and+Alerting
• Security FAQ (customer-facing guardrails): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SECF/Siem+Audit+Export+Beta+Security+FAQ
• Splunk HEC internal guide (CS/SE): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/CS/Splunk+HEC+Audit+Export+Integration+Internal+Guide

If you’re enabling for a customer this week, please post in this thread w/ the tenant + destination so SRE knows what to watch.

INTake Bot: Ticket template reminder: INT-9012 requires (1) tenant_id, (2) destination type, (3) destination hostname/bucket, (4) support owner, (5) security reviewer if non-standard setup.

Talia Benson: Adding a bit more process here — we’re limiting to a small cohort. Please don’t “surprise enable” without PM signoff.
• Beta cohort target: 3–5 accounts
• Weekly check-ins are required (CS owner + PM)
• If customer asks for Private/on-prem, capture requirements but don’t commit timelines.

Naomi Feldman: +1. Also: please use this language if asked about guarantees: **“at-least-once delivery with checkpointing + retries; downstream should deduplicate using `event_id`.”**
If anyone needs the one-paragraph blurb for customer comms, ping me.

Sean Gallagher: From SRE side: we’re watching export lag + adapter error rate closely. If you enable a high-volume tenant, please flag it explicitly so we can adjust alert thresholds.

Rafael Mendes: Runbook callout: for downstream throttling (Splunk 429 / Datadog rate limits), first action is usually **pause export** for that destination and coordinate token/key rotation only if auth errors.

Marcus Lin: Security reminder:
• Don’t log destination secrets in Slack/Jira
• Destination validation/egress allowlist is enforced — if customer has a weird endpoint, route through Security Eng before enabling
• PII minimization: audit payload should not include request/response bodies; if you see it, file a bug and stop.

Kevin Osei: Also for compliance questionnaires: Redwood retains audit logs per policy; **customer SIEM retention is their responsibility**. Please don’t state that SIEM export is a “backup” of retention.

Elliot Price: Docs note — Console page is “Settings → Audit Export” (admin-only). Draft admin guide is being finalized; until then, the FAQ above is the safest link to share internally.

Kira Thompson: If you’re on support rotation and get questions about “missing events,” check **lag** first. Most of the early reports have been “delayed due to throttling,” not actual loss.

Logan Wright: Dashboards are live in Grafana (internal): https://grafana.redwoodinference.com/d/audit-exporter/overview (export lag / retries / adapter errors). If you need a per-tenant breakdown, reply with tenant_id and I can help.

Miguel Santos: For CS folks: if you’re looping me in on a beta customer, please include their SIEM contact + preferred validation plan (sample events, expected index/source). Splunk customers almost always want a “test connection” + a known event to search for.

Connor O'Brien: Thanks all. Reactions are fine for FYI; but if you’re requesting enablement, please comment with:
• tenant_id
• destination
• expected volume (rough)
• owner (CS/SE)
so we can keep rollout clean.

Connor O'Brien: (and reminder: kill switch exists; if something looks off, SRE can disable quickly while we triage).
